title: Agent-Based Disruption Simulation on an Edge-Level Product-Annotated Supply Network of the Automotive Industry
abstract: arXiv:2611.01706v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Disruptions spread through supply networks when customers cannot replace the products they lose. We ask how portfolio-overlap and product-specific rules for selecting candidate suppliers change cascades when customers search for new suppliers and form new supply edges. From the MarkLines database, we construct a product-annotated network of about 77,000 firms and 197,000 supplier-customer edges in the global automotive industry. We extend an agent-based disruption model with edge-level products, a product-specific substitution rule based on the semantic similarity of product names, and calibrated capacities and inventories. Only 6% of the edges carry observed products. We impute the others and test the imputation against the annotated edges. We run 119,000 simulations. translated_title: 基于智能体的汽车产业边级产品标注供应网络中断模拟研究
translated_abstract: 当客户无法替换失去的产品时，中断会在供应网络中蔓延。我们研究当客户搜索新供应商并形成新的供应边时，基于产品组合重叠和产品特定的候选供应商选择规则如何改变级联效应。基于MarkLines数据库，我们构建了一个全球汽车产业的产品标注网络，包含约77,000家企业和197,000条供应商-客户边。我们扩展了一个基于智能体的中断模型，加入了边级产品、基于产品名称语义相似性的产品特定替代规则，以及经校准的产能和库存。只有6%的边携带观测到的产品，我们对其余边进行插补，并对照已标注的边检验插补效果。我们运行了119,000次模拟。在所有其他机制保持不变的情况下，产品特定规则使得枢纽失效后的级联中断规模比原始基于产品组合重叠的规则大四到五倍。
tldr: 该研究构建了包含约7.7万家企业的全球汽车产业产品标注供应网络，通过智能体模拟发现，基于产品名称语义相似性的特定产品替代规则会使枢纽失效引发的级联中断规模比传统产品组合重叠规则大四到五倍。
en_tdlr: Using an agent-based disruption simulation on a product-annotated automotive supply network of ~77,000 firms, this study shows that a product-specific substitution rule based on semantic similarity of product names produces cascades four to five times larger than a portfolio-overlap rule after a hub failure.
